text: DeepSeek-鲸鱼娘是面向 DSH Web 客户端的轻量主题插件，通过原生主题服务注册浅色配色，并在页面背景叠加鲸鱼娘插画与纸面效果。它提供可实时调整的壁纸显示、缩放、位置和模糊，表面、对话区及用户气泡透明度，主框模糊、输入框聚焦光晕和三套预设。插件详情页提供设置表单及中英文界面；偏好保存在当前浏览器本地。适合想个性化 DSH 网页外观、同时保留文字对比度的用户；需要 DSH Web 配置，无需额外 API 密钥。

DeepSeek Whale Girl is a light theme for DSH Web. It adds a native palette and whale-girl wallpaper, with controls for wallpaper, blur, surface and chat opacity, and focus glow. Preferences are saved in the browser. For users who want a customizable DSH web appearance; no API key is needed.
想给 DSH 网页界面换一套浅色主题
能不能在聊天背景放自己的风格壁纸并调透明度
我想分别调整对话区和侧边页面的背景透光程度
让 DSH 网页的背景图可以缩放、移动焦点和模糊
有没有能实时调玻璃感和输入框聚焦光晕的主题
DSH 的主题怎么换成鲸鱼娘插画配色
I want a customizable light theme and wallpaper for the DSH web UI.
Can I tune chat transparency separately from the rest of the interface?
DeepSeek-鲸鱼娘 的功能「壁纸控制」：可在插件设置页开关环境壁纸，并实时调整插画的缩放、垂直焦点、模糊和遮罩强度。设置即时写入当前浏览器的本地偏好。
DeepSeek-鲸鱼娘 的功能「分区透明度」：提供全局表面、对话区域和用户气泡的独立透明度控制，让聊天纸面可单独透出壁纸而不改变菜单等页面。
DeepSeek-鲸鱼娘 的功能「浅色主题」：插件挂载时向 DSH 原生主题服务注册 Whale Girl 浅色配色并设为当前主题；关闭插件后清理主题样式和页面标记。
DeepSeek-鲸鱼娘 的功能「主题设置卡」：在已安装插件详情页提供双语设置卡，可实时改外观并选择预设；设置槽不可用时尝试回退到旧卡片位置。

DeepSeek-鲸鱼娘 (Whale Girl) theme for the [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (DSH) Web UI — a native light theme built from the DreamSkin palette, with the whale-girl artwork behind a light paper layer and live glass, wallpaper and conversation-paper controls.

dsh-theme-whalegirl README · What it does：- **Full token remap** — registers one light theme (`deepseek-whalegirl`) into DSH's native theme runtime with a complete `--dsw-*` dictionary (174 tokens): every surface, label, border, button, markdown block, scrollbar and state color derives from the DreamSkin palette.
- **Light paper, not heavy frost** — the whale-girl artwork sits as a fixed backdrop behind the UI. Since 0.2.x the app-frame blur is 1px by default and the main column carries a single paper layer, so about 14% of the artwork reads through while body text keeps its contrast.
- **Conversation-only paper opacity** — since 0.3.0 a separate slider controls the transcript column only. Long chats can show more wallpaper without making the home page, menus or plugin pages more translucent; those keep the global surface setting.
- **Settings on the installed package page** — the form is contributed as the bundle's own configuration (`plugins.bundle.config`), so it appears on **Plugins → Installed → dsh-theme-whalegirl**, above the component list. It is no longer part of the built-in configuration cards.
- **Adjustable glass & wallpaper** — frame blur, global surface and bubble tr

dsh-theme-whalegirl README · local checkout：The theme applies immediately once the plugin mounts. While the plugin is enabled it owns the appearance: a light/dark pick in Settings → General → Appearance is reclaimed, because the same write happens on the desktop's own cold start. To switch back to the built-in appearance, disable the plugin (market Themes tab, or its installed-package page); toggling it on again brings the theme back.

dsh-theme-whalegirl README · Settings：Open **Plugins → Installed → dsh-theme-whalegirl** and use the **「鲸鱼娘 · 玻璃与壁纸」** form. Every change applies instantly; values are stored in this browser's localStorage (`dsh-whalegirl.prefs.v2`), not in the profile.

dsh-theme-whalegirl README · Compatibility：- Requires a DSH web client profile (`dsh.client.platform: "web"`, client bundle via `exports["./client"]`).
- DSH `>= 0.1.6` is declared in `engines.dsh`; tested on DSH 0.2.1-rc.5. The client declares `inject: ["theme", "slots"]`, so the settings form's `ctx.slots` access is legal and every service probe falls back to `ctx.get()` instead of throwing. A host without the slots service still gets the full theme; only the optional settings entry is skipped.
- No upper bound is declared on purpose: the theme is visual-only, and a false ceiling would hide it from newer hosts that in fact work. What a real breakage does is drop the hook report on the settings card to `宿主适配 2/3` and log the missing selector — please paste that line into an issue.
- Light appearance only — the source skin ships one light palette.
- Works alongside other plugins; nothing outside the gated body attribute `data-dsh-whalegirl` is touched when disabled.

dsh-theme-whalegirl README · Paper model：The host's surface ownership differs per shell: the macOS titlebar layout gives the center/right columns `--dsw-alias-bg-base`, while the browser layout paints no column background and lets each page (conversation root, dock tab host) paint it. The skin owns the column surface itself: `[class*="_centerCol"]`/`[class*="_rightbarCol"]` carry the paper on every platform, the conversation root and `[class*="_tabHost"]` stay transparent, so every page has exactly one paper layer (~86% opaque at the default, ~14% wallpaper). The sidebar paints the same token twice (the layout column and the sidebar's own `_root`); the skin blanks the inner fill and paints the wash once from the column.

dsh-theme-whalegirl README · Paper model：Since 0.3.0, `[class*="_centerCol"]:has([data-slot="conversation.header"])` re-emits `--dsw-alias-bg-base` with the conversation-only value. The right sidebar, home, menus and plugin pages keep the global `表面透明度`.

dsh-theme-whalegirl README · Development：```sh
npm run build        # wrap src/client.js into lib/client.js + embed assets/background.jpg
npm test             # smoke test: register/guard/card/dispose against a mocked DOM
npm run check        # verify lib/ matches src/ (CI)
npm run test:browser -- --url "http://127.0.0.1:5190/?token=…"   # real Chromium, computed styles

The build is dependency-free (plain Node). `lib/` is committed so installs never need a build step.

dsh-theme-whalegirl README · Development：`npm test` proves the plugin's logic; it cannot see the things that actually broke in the past (two paper layers composing to ~99% white, the web sidebar rendering solid where the desktop showed the wallpaper, a cold-start presenter overwriting the palette). `npm run test:browser` boots a real DSH web profile and asserts computed styles instead of strings: the label colour lands on `#352970`, the wallpaper paints behind a single translucent column (alpha ≈ 0.86 at the default, ≈ 0.48 at 95%), preferences survive a reload, and no page error is raised. Boot any profile for it — a throwaway one keeps your own clean:

dsh-theme-whalegirl README · Development：```sh
dsh --profile whalecheck --from-default-profile web --dump-config   # create without booting
dsh plugin --profile whalecheck add -w link:"$PWD"
dsh --profile whalecheck --no-open --port 5190                      # prints the token URL
```

Playwright is resolved from a local install, `npm root -g`, or the npx cache; if its Chromium was never downloaded the script falls back to the system Chrome.
